intro.text: A Shin soldier who served under Szeth.

items.text: Around 1157 Jathen was one of about fifteen elite soldiers who starved themselves to look scrawny and surrendered as slaves to raiders from Steen, planning to cut free with blades hidden in their mouths and burn the ships. On Jathen's ship he, his brother and three others were tied to the mast and beaten, and Szeth had to rescue them. Freed among the first, Jathen took charge, gathered bows and readied a rowboat, and helped the injured get away.
